topic: Five extra iterations on phase 016's research into Product Owner's sk-create-figjam packet and its integration with sk-product-owner. Read the earlier synthesis first, in full: AI Systems/Product Owner/specs/017-figjam-flow-generation/016-figjam-improvement-research/research/research.md (its citations under research/corpus/ resolve to the same repos under specs/z-staging-po-016b-research/corpus/). All 12 of its ranked changes are now implemented, as phases 017 to 028 of the packet (each phase's implementation-summary.md under AI Systems/Product Owner/specs/017-figjam-flow-generation/0NN-*/ says what it changed): the verified board URL in the artifact's Flows group, the artifact-plus-board pair through the router's then field, the hosted route connection, the accent and cut test, the screenshot critic pass, node tags as metadata, the kernel no-connector sentence, the Flow delivery pointers, the plan through whoami, self-edit guidance, repeated edge labels and read-back direction. Do not re-propose any of the 12. Work these, one or more per iteration, and name the earlier iteration or research.md section each builds on: (1) read the changed sources and check each implemented change against the corpus line it came from, naming anything the implementation left out, got wrong or worded so a model would misread it; (2) deepen what research.md section 5 rejected and section 7 left unverified, and settle what can be settled from public docs: the hosted Figma MCP tool list, whoami, the fields get_figjam returns, and whether use_figma allows setPluginData or setSharedPluginData; (3) widen the corpus with web search for FigJam skills, MCP servers, plugins and Figma docs published after the pins, citing URLs where no local file exists; (4) find integration gaps that remain, among them the known router gap where "write a doc about onboarding and draw it on a figjam board" and "write a bug about it and add a figjam diagram" still route to FLOW alone, the claude.ai Project's Flow path, ClickUp handoff of a board URL and the playbooks.
